name: Non-blocking regular-file reads for host journals and sidecars
summary: regular_file.open_regular and read_regular_text, behind the admin.read_regular_text facade, open or read one host-owned regular file without following links or blocking on a FIFO. They check the opened descriptor's type and identity, support streaming bytes, strict UTF-8 text or raw bytes, total byte bounds, prefix reads and opened-descriptor validation. Host journal, sidecar, operation-receipt and task-file blob readers delegate to this shared guard while retaining their family-specific missing, damaged and unreadable classifications.
